text: The ROCKWOOL Foundation, a non-commercial foundation established in December 1981 by six members of the Kähler family, is ROCKWOOL A/S's largest single shareholder, owning 23 percent of the share capital and 28 percent of the votes. The Foundation exercises its ownership through participation in the General Meetings of ROCKWOOL A/S.
